metric: object-level extraction precision/recall/F1 against gold nontext objects (per family img/tab), per document then micro-aggregated per (format, domain) cell; no global composite score
authority: external review R-C (ADOPTION.md §132) skeleton + this pre-registration completes the matching rule; revisions require a new ledger ruling before any real-corpus run
gold_objects: annotation nontext units' nontext_ref (^(img|tab):\S+$), family = prefix, reading order = units list order
predicted_objects: system Document elements with type in {image->img, table->tab}, reading order = elements list order; only these two types in scope

matching_rule.pdf: within family, page-number sequence alignment via difflib.SequenceMatcher(autojunk=False); equal page numbers inside matching blocks pair one-to-one; robust to insertion/deletion/shift; gold or predicted objects with missing (null/non-int) page never pair (count FN/FP respectively, never a false TP)
matching_rule.docx: within family, ordinal alignment (k-th gold <-> k-th predicted, TP = min(|G|,|P|)); disclosed as ordinal not identity matching because neither side has physical pages

na_rules: doc-level parse_failed:<code>/empty_result/annotation_invalid -> all families null with na_reason, counted in cell na_docs, never silently dropped; precision denominator 0 -> null reason=no_predictions (review: zero-prediction N/A); recall denominator 0 -> null reason=no_gold_objects; f1 null when either parent null or precision+recall==0; cell with zero scorable docs -> null reason=no_scorable_docs; never fabricate 1.0 on zero denominators
aggregation: cells keyed (format, domain) from manifest (authoritative); family tp/fp/fn micro-summed within cell then rates computed; na_docs disclosed per cell
discipline: no real gold run before G6 freeze; module is pure functions only, no CLI; G7 wiring must gate on gold revision like stage9.system_eval
